# PND50 - AI Boutique Accounting & Consultant Thailand

## Company Overview
PND50 is a boutique accounting and consulting firm based in Bangkok, Thailand, specializing in serving foreign-owned businesses. Founded in 2014, PND50 combines human expertise with AI-powered tools to deliver 5x faster and error-free accounting, tax filing, and business consulting services.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is PND50 tax filing?
PND50 (ภ.ง.ด.50) is the annual corporate income tax return that all companies registered in Thailand must file within 150 days after their fiscal year ends.

### How much does accounting cost in Thailand?
Accounting fees typically range from 5,000-50,000 THB per month depending on transaction volume. PND50 offers packages starting from 8,000 THB/month.

### Can foreigners own 100% of a Thai company?
Yes, in certain business types and with BOI promotion or Foreign Business Act exemptions. Consult PND50 for structure advice.

### Do I need a Thai accountant?
Yes, all Thailand-registered companies must maintain records in Thai Baht per Thai Accounting Standards.
